label: Confirmed
text: On 24 September 2026, The Clearing House (TCH) announced that it had selected Quant to power its On-Chain Money Initiative, a network for clearing and settling tokenised deposits between financial institutions.

label: Confirmed
text: Quant says its technology will provide the network's interoperability, orchestration and transaction-management layer, with connections to existing fiat payment systems such as RTP and CHIPS.

label: Confirmed
text: TCH expects the network to be available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027.

label: Confirmed
text: The initiative was first unveiled in June 2026 as a bank-led effort that TCH operates.

label: Confirmed
text: Quant also says it will offer a shared Tokenised Deposits-as-a-Service platform to US institutions that process through TCH but do not yet have tokenised deposit capability.
